features: three connectivity variants: 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, 2.4/5GHz dual-band Wi-Fi, and 4G LTE

home_assistant.notes: Wi-Fi variants (2.4GHz / 2.4-5GHz dual-band) expose ONVIF + RTSP after a firmware update, enabling local NVR/HA use. The 4G variant is cloud-only. ONVIF is surfaced in the LaView app rather than the public datasheet.

release_notes: Sold in three connectivity variants (2.4GHz Wi-Fi, 2.4/5GHz dual-band Wi-Fi, 4G LTE) plus a 4K Wi-Fi option. NVR compatibility applies to the Wi-Fi variants via ONVIF/RTSP after a firmware update (community-verified, #226); the 4G variant remains cloud-only.
